verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline as the clear focal point, puts source and rating on one tidy line and anchors the logo at the right, which reads left to right. Its flaws: the text block starts about 160px in with nothing to its left, the quote mark has shrunk to a speck, and the logo is small and isolated far from the copy. B stacks four tight lines (quote mark, headline, source, rating) into the left half. Its headline is shrunk and the cyan source line is nearly as big as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy. The rating is tiny, and the right half of the banner is empty, so the layout is lopsided.
